DML.SELECT: SELECT incident_type_id as "incidentTypeId", ini_incident_state_id as "iniIncidentStateId", end_incident_state_id as "endIncidentStateId", auto as "auto", enabled as "enabled", visible as "visible" FROM conf.ims_incident_type_state_transitions WHERE enabled = true or enabled is null
DML.INSERT: INSERT INTO conf.ims_incident_type_state_transitions (incident_type_id, ini_incident_state_id, end_incident_state_id, auto, enabled, visible, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (:incidentTypeId, :iniIncidentStateId, :endIncidentStateId, :auto, :enabled, :visible, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
DML.UPDATE: UPDATE conf.ims_incident_type_state_transitions SET end_incident_state_id = :endIncidentStateId, auto = :auto, enabled = :enabled, visible = :visible, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE incident_type_id = :incidentTypeId AND ini_incident_state_id = :iniIncidentStateId
DML.DELETE: DELETE FROM conf.ims_incident_type_state_transitions WHERE incident_type_id = :incidentTypeId AND ini_incident_state_id = :iniIncidentStateId
